The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of mobile browsing, the network conditions experienced by a client can be a key factor for determining when and how to use middleboxes to accelerate web page transfers.
, to achieve the best possible performance, mobile browsers must be aware of the network conditions and use them to make intelligent decisions about how to fetch web objects and how to compress them.
, to maximize benefits from compression for mobile web browsing in the presence of a middlebox, it is necessary to consider the network conditions of the client.
